method.identity: Codex assistant in the F5 development chat; same assistant that implemented the harness
method.limitations: Single non-blinded AI reviewer, no independently pinned judge model and no second reviewer. Exploratory rubric was finalized while inspecting this pilot, not preregistered. Only rendered GroundedText fields are counted; structural strings and overall answer scope were inspected separately. Judgments test support by the supplied corpus, not real-world truth of that corpus. Repetitions and related fields are correlated.

semantic.scope: validated GroundedText fields and their citation links; card context inspected, structural strings not counted as separately cited claims

billing.attribution: Account-wide change over the measured window; concurrent activity was not independently excluded. Raw balances are private. This is not a per-request invoice.
